    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.links = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.depth = None
        self.progress = None
        self.pos = []

    def copy(self):
        res = Dinic(self.n)
        res.links = [[a[:] for a in b] for b in self.links]
        res.pos = [a[:] for a in self.pos]
        return res

    def add_edge(self, _from, to, cap):
        self.pos.append((_from, len(self.links[_from])))
        self.links[_from].append([cap, to, len(self.links[to])])
        self.links[to].append([0, _from, len(self.links[_from]) - 1])

    def bfs(self, s):
        from collections import deque

        depth = [-1] * self.n
        depth[s] = 0
        q = deque([s])
        while q:
            v = q.popleft()
            for cap, to, _ in self.links[v]:
                if cap > 0 and depth[to] < 0:
                    depth[to] = depth[v] + 1
                    q.append(to)
        self.depth = depth

    def dfs(self, v, t, flow):
        if v == t:
            return flow
        links_v = self.links[v]
        for i in range(self.progress[v], len(links_v)):
            self.progress[v] = i
            cap, to, rev = link = links_v[i]
            if cap == 0 or self.depth[v] >= self.depth[to]:

            d = self.dfs(to, t, min(flow, cap))
            if d == 0:
                continue
            link[0] -= d
            self.links[to][rev][0] += d
            return d
        return 0

    def flow(self, s, t):
        INF = Dinic.INF
        flow = 0

                return flow
            self.progress = [0] * self.n
            current_flow = self.dfs(s, t, INF)
            while current_flow > 0:
                flow += current_flow
                current_flow = self.dfs(s, t, INF)

    def get_edge(self, i):

        re = self.links[e[1]][e[2]]
        # from, to, cap, flow

        res = []

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Dinic {
        static final long INF = 1000000000000000000L;
        int n;
        List<Edge>[] links;
        int[] depth;
        int[] progress;
        List<int[]> pos;

        static class Edge {
            long cap;
            int to;
            int rev;

            Edge(long cap, int to, int rev) {
                this.cap = cap;
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
            }
        }

        Dinic(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            this.links = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) links[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            this.pos = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, long cap) {
            pos.add(new int[]{from, links[from].size()});
            links[from].add(new Edge(cap, to, links[to].size()));
            links[to].add(new Edge(0, from, links[from].size() - 1));
        }

        void bfs(int s) {
            depth = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(depth, -1);
            depth[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : links[v]) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && depth[e.to] < 0) {
                        depth[e.to] = depth[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long dfs(int v, int t, long flow) {
            if (v == t) return flow;
            for (int i = progress[v]; i < links[v].size(); i++) {
                progress[v] = i;
                Edge e = links[v].get(i);
                if (e.cap == 0 || depth[v] >= depth[e.to]) continue;
                long d = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                if (d == 0) continue;
                e.cap -= d;
                links[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += d;
                return d;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                bfs(s);
                if (depth[t] < 0) return flow;
                progress = new int[n];
                long currentFlow = dfs(s, t, INF);
                while (currentFlow > 0) {
                    flow += currentFlow;
                    currentFlow = dfs(s, t, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line1 = br.readLine();
        if (line1 == null) return;
        int N = Integer.parseInt(line1.trim());
        
        String lineA = br.readLine();
        String[] partsA = lineA.trim().split("\\s+");
        long[] A = new long[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) A[i] = Long.parseLong(partsA[i]);
        
        String lineB = br.readLine();
        String[] partsB = lineB.trim().split("\\s+");
        long[] B = new long[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) B[i] = Long.parseLong(partsB[i]);

        long ans1 = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            ans1 += Math.min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % 3]);
        }

        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(2 * 3 + 2);
        int s = 2 * 3;
        int t = 2 * 3 + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            dinic.addEdge(s, i, N);
            dinic.addEdge(3 + i, t, B[i]);
            dinic.addEdge(i, 3 + i, A[i]);
            dinic.addEdge(i, 3 + (i + 2) % 3, A[i]); // (i-1)%3 in Python is (i+2)%3 in Java for positive
        }
        
        long ans2 = N - dinic.maxFlow(s, t);
        System.out.println(ans2 + " " + ans1);
    }
}
